initialExam.title: Maharashtra Police Constable 2026
initialExam.description: Maharashtra Police Constable recruitment for state police, state reserve police, and armed police battalions across Maharashtra.
initialExam.eligibility: 12th pass (HSC) from Maharashtra State Board or equivalent
initialExam.syllabus: Marathi, English, GK, Mathematics, Reasoning, Maharashtra GK.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Test: 100 marks, 90 minutes. PET. Medical.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Physical Test → Medical → Document Verification → Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Police Constable in Maharashtra State Police
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → PSI → PI → ACP → DCP.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit mahapolice.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Uniform, Pension, Government quarters
